## 每日概要
* 航班資訊: **星宇航空 JX314**（09:30 台中 RMQ ✈️ 14:00 成田 NRT）
* 住宿飯店: [錦糸町京成 Richmond 飯店](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Keisei+Richmond+Hotel+Tokyo+Kinshicho/@35.6936367,139.8123638,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m9!3m8!1s0x601888d88d1ab3bd:0x254b91a22fe762a!5m2!4m1!1i2!8m2!3d35.6936367!4d139.8149441!16s%2Fg%2F11nxg6dvvq?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=b2886cee-634f-4466-8502-7977afab5202)

## 行程

### 上午: 班機出發（星宇航空 JX314）
* 07:30 抵達[台中機場](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Taichung+International+Airport/@24.2620608,120.6218378,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x346911535f840371:0x586410335e8a5024!8m2!3d24.2620608!4d120.6244181!16s%2Fm%2F026x_13!18m1!1e1?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=b50e70b8-748b-4ea9-b26a-dd443bbec8e5) (RMQ) 第 2 航廈，辦理報到與託運行李。
* 09:30 搭乘星宇航空 **JX314** 起飛前往東京成田機場 (NRT)。

### 下午: 成田機場入境 -> 錦糸町
* 14:00 預計抵達[成田機場](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Narita+International+Airport+(NRT),+1-1+Furugome,+Narita,+Chiba+282-0004,+Japan&ftid=0x6022f379d1bd3757:0xd56e29a162771aa1&entry=gps&shh=CAE&lucs=,94297699,94231188,94280568,47071704,94218641,94282134,100813464,94286869,100820247,100822499&g_ep=CAISEjI2LjMyLjUuOTU4MDQ3MzAzMBgAIIgnKl0sOTQyOTc2OTksOTQyMzExODgsOTQyODA1NjgsNDcwNzE3MDQsOTQyMTg2NDEsOTQyODIxMzQsMTAwODEzNDY0LDk0Mjg2ODY5LDEwMDgyMDI0NywxMDA4MjI0OTlCAkNB&skid=c938945b-953a-4443-b74c-91bf10bc04c5)第 2 航廈，辦理入境與提領行李。
* 交通方式: 
  * [Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Narita+International+Airport,+1-1+Furugome,+Narita,+Chiba+282-0004,+Japan/Keisei+Richmond+Hotel+Tokyo+Kinshicho,+3+Chome-2-7+Kotobashi,+Sumida+City,+Tokyo+130-0022,+Japan/@35.7401416,139.4201342,9z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x6022f379d1bd3757:0xd56e29a162771aa1!2m2!1d140.3843215!2d35.770178!1m5!1m1!1s0x601888d88d1ab3bd:0x254b91a22fe762a!2m2!1d139.8149441!2d35.6936367!3e3!18m1!1e1?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) 錦糸町京成 Richmond 飯店 辦理入住或寄放行李。
